projects.description: A personal Nx monorepo housing all of my side projects — Next.js apps, a Go API, and Python Telegram bots — sharing CI/CD, linting, and release tooling instead of each living in its own repo.
projects.eli5: Like keeping every hobby project in one shared workshop with a common set of tools, instead of a separate workshop (and separate toolbox) for each one.
projects.name: core-repository

projects.description: A Telegram bot that tracks stock market index drawdowns and notifies subscribers when things drop.
projects.eli5: A friend who watches the market all day and only taps you on the shoulder when it's dropped a lot.
projects.name: index-watch

projects.description: A Telegram bot that deals themed conversation-starter cards to liven up group chats.
projects.eli5: A digital card deck that gives your group chat something better to talk about than the weather.
projects.name: table-talks

projects.description: A home server built from spare parts left over from years of building and upgrading my own gaming PCs, running my own storage and services instead of renting space from a cloud provider. One service it runs is Immich, a self-hosted replacement for Google Photos.
projects.eli5: Instead of paying rent to store my stuff in someone else's warehouse, I built my own shed in the backyard — out of spare parts I already had lying around from years of upgrading my gaming PC.
projects.name: Self-hosted NAS
